Fall to the bottom of each chapter to find its map page. Play them in any order.

  • Drag left side steer
  • Tap right side fireballs, or jump on a ledge
  • Hold right side hover
  • Swipe down Jet Dive
  • Land on enemies stomp (not spiky ones)

Each chapter ends in a treasure landing that holds one torn page. Find the first four to open the way into the Volcano Core.
